title: Nightly Platform Review
description: Reads this platform's telemetry and agent conversations once a night and PROPOSES changes as pull requests. Applies nothing. Ships inert: dryRun true. REQUIRED BY core-provider, which derives the Composition CRD from this file.

global.title: Global values (injected by the Krateo composition engine)

clickhouseQueries.title: Evidence queries
clickhouseQueries.description: Named SQL as configuration rather than code, so it is reviewable and adaptable without a new image. {from}/{to} are substituted; nothing else is.

kagentDbHost.description: In-cluster address of kagent's Postgres. Reached directly and never through the gateway, because this is a database connection rather than an API call that per-user RBAC could be applied to.

kagentDb.description: Credential for kagent's Postgres, read for session METADATA across every user. The role named here must hold SELECT on `session` and nothing else: conversation content lives in event.data and task, and the role is explicitly REVOKEd on both. That narrowness is a database privilege, NOT something this chart enforces — verify it where the role is created (session=t, event=f, task=f). No `default` on any leaf here, deliberately: an empty name must mean not-configured so the source reports it and the run is PartiallyCompleted, rather than a default silently standing in.
